subject: I wasn't going to send you this secret feature
preview_text: Built something extra for you. A hidden way to see patterns you're missing. This changes how you scan.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing the data from the last 800+ scans and saw something that made me pause. A pattern so subtle, most people miss it completely. It's the gap between what you're looking for and what's actually happening.

So I built a new layer into the scanner. I wasn't planning to share it yet—it was just for my own research. But then I realized: you're the exact person who needs to see this. It connects the dots between separate conversations to show you the slow-burn red flags. The ones that don't scream, they whisper.

It's live in your app right now. Open any past scan in your dashboard, and you'll see a new 'Pattern Timeline' button. Tap it. It will show you how behaviors evolve over time. It's the difference between seeing a single red flag and seeing the whole toxic blueprint.

Open the app and check your last scan. The timeline will show you what you've been feeling but couldn't quite prove. P.S. This feature disappears in 48 hours. I'm testing it with a small group first, and you're in it.
